title: Drill-through lists more records than the number when a dataset or one of its measures declares a filter: the analytics answer carries no per-measure drill scope
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWn6zhNa4LL7VB1rtL

Filing gate: ① (a drill that lists records the number does not count; named producer below) and ④ (cross-layer: carries the analytics half of #30080; #30080 keeps the dashboard tile click, and waits on this card). No `domain:*` label: triage routes this card (the fix lands in `packages/spec` and `packages/services/service-analytics`).

## Observed

Measured by the #30080 card thread on `main` `fa9c0aa2` (code reading), seat spot-check on `origin/main`:

- A dataset tile's or cell's number is computed under three filters at once: the dataset's own `filter`, the measure's own `filter`, and the widget's runtime filter (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts`: `combineFilters(compiled.filter, selection.runtimeFilter)`, and `splitMeasuresByFilter` runs one supplementary query per filtered measure).
- The client sees only the last one. The dataset answer's drill sidecars (`dimensionFields`, `drillRawRows`, `drillRanges` in `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts`, ADR-0021 D2) describe the bucket, not the dataset or measure filter; the `DataSource` interface has no read of a dataset definition, and `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard` has no metadata client.
- So every drill surface builds its list filter from the bucket plus the widget filter only (the report drill in `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, the dashboard chart and table drill `openDrill` in `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`). A drill on a filtered measure lists more records than the number says.

reach: named real producer: `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/datasets/revenue-pulse.dataset.ts:32` declares `paid_count` (`aggregate: 'count', filter: { status: 'paid' }`), drawn by `revenue-pulse.dashboard.ts:76` (`table_rate_by_status`). A filtered measure is the spec's own conditional-count spelling, so any author can write it today.

## Wanted

- The dataset answer carries a per-measure drill scope beside the existing drill sidecars: for each measure, the list filter that selects exactly the records it counts (the dataset's `filter` ∧ the measure's `filter`), in the same vocabulary `drillRanges` uses. When it cannot be expressed as a list filter (a derived measure, a relation path the list cannot filter on), the scope is absent for that measure.
- Drill surfaces compose bucket ∧ widget filter ∧ that scope, and offer no drill for a measure whose scope is absent — the rule the maintainer ruled for tiles on #30080: "A tile whose dataset filter cannot be expressed as a list filter offers no click, rather than a list that does not match the number."

Governing text: ADR-0021 D2 (the server answers the drill bounds; the client never restates dataset semantics); the ruling on #30080 (comment 6631202970). Precedent for the shape: `drillRanges` (#20700) and the `timeDimensions` drill bounds (#27074) — the server sends what the drill needs.

## Who acts, and in what order

1. The spec seat: the answer field in `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts` (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, a published API answer; contract review at its tier).
2. The server seat: `service-analytics` serves it (and the `data-objectstack` passthrough if it filters sidecars).
3. `ui`: #30080 consumes it for the tile click. The switch of the existing report / chart / table drills to the scope is a `ui` card the landing seat files when this lands.

Business reason: a manager clicks "Paid Invoices: 12" and must see those 12 invoices, not every invoice of the period; a drill that does not match the number teaches people to stop trusting the dashboard.

Dedupe: `drill measure filter`, `drill scope dataset filter`, `drillRanges`, `measure filter drill-through` (is:issue, open and closed): 67 / 51 / 10 / 12 hits, none open on this gap (closest closed: #27074, #20700, #20644).
